theorem PV_DIAG7.DIAG_optionB_public_signal : ∀ {W P C : Type} (pub : W → P) (coins : W → C)
  (publicSignal : P → C → Signal) (program : P → C → Nat → Program) (initial : P → C → State)
  (existingL1Count : P → C → Nat) (w u : W),
  pub w = pub u →
    coins w = coins u →
      (fun n =>
          DIAG_inputs (existingL1Count (pub w) (coins w))
            (run (publicSignal (pub w) (coins w)) (program (pub w) (coins w) n) (initial (pub w) (coins w)))
            (calls (publicSignal (pub w) (coins w)) (program (pub w) (coins w) n) (initial (pub w) (coins w)))) =
        fun n =>
        DIAG_inputs (existingL1Count (pub u) (coins u))
          (run (publicSignal (pub u) (coins u)) (program (pub u) (coins u) n) (initial (pub u) (coins u)))
          (calls (publicSignal (pub u) (coins u)) (program (pub u) (coins u) n) (initial (pub u) (coins u))) :=
fun {W P C} pub coins publicSignal program initial existingL1Count w u hp hc =>
  DIAG_public_given_optionB pub coins (fun w => publicSignal (pub w) (coins w))
    (public_signal_satisfies_P pub coins publicSignal) program initial existingL1Count w u hp hc
theorem PV_DIAG7.DIAG_native_handoff : ∀ {W P C O : Type} (native : W → Nat → Execution State Reply) (pub : W → P)
  (coins : W → C) (environment : W → Signal),
  V400_OptionB_P pub coins environment →
    ∀ (program : P → C → Nat → Program) (initial : P → C → State),
      (∀ (w : W) (n : Nat),
          native w n = run (environment w) (program (pub w) (coins w) n) (initial (pub w) (coins w))) →
        ∀ (decode : Execution State Reply → O) (w u : W),
          pub w = pub u → coins w = coins u → (fun n => decode (native w n)) = fun n => decode (native u n) :=
fun {W P C O} native pub coins environment V400 program initial sourceBinding decode w u hp hc =>
  funext fun n =>
    Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => decode _a = decode (native u n)) (sourceBinding w n)))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              decode (run (environment w) (program (pub w) (coins w) n) (initial (pub w) (coins w))) = decode _a)
            (sourceBinding u n)))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                decode (run _a (program (pub w) (coins w) n) (initial (pub w) (coins w))) =
                  decode (run (environment u) (program (pub u) (coins u) n) (initial (pub u) (coins u))))
              (V400 w u hp hc)))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  decode (run (environment u) (program _a (coins w) n) (initial _a (coins w))) =
                    decode (run (environment u) (program (pub u) (coins u) n) (initial (pub u) (coins u))))
                hp))
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a =>
                    decode (run (environment u) (program (pub u) _a n) (initial (pub u) _a)) =
                      decode (run (environment u) (program (pub u) (coins u) n) (initial (pub u) (coins u))))
                  hc))
              (Eq.refl (decode (run (environment u) (program (pub u) (coins u) n) (initial (pub u) (coins u)))))))))
